actions.addLead.description: Add a lead to an outbound campaign to be called by an AI assistant.
actions.addLead.props.allow_dupplicate.d: Allow the same phone number to be added to the campaign more than once
actions.addLead.props.num_secondary_cont: How many secondary contacts do you want to add? (Max: 10)
actions.addLead.props.phone_number.descr: Enter the phone number of the customer (E.164 format: +1234567890)
actions.addLead.props.secondary_contacts: Add secondary contacts for this lead. Each contact can have its own phone number and variables.
actions.addLead.props.variables.descript: Variables to pass to the assistant
actions.campaignControl.description: Start or stop an outbound calling campaign.
actions.campaignControl.props.action.des: Select the action to perform on the campaign
actions.createCampaign.description: Create a new outbound calling campaign.
actions.createCampaign.props.allowed_day: Leave empty to use API default (all days). Otherwise restrict to selected days.
actions.createCampaign.props.assistant_i: Select the AI assistant to use for the call
actions.createCampaign.props.goal_comple: Name of a boolean variable from the assistant post-call schema (max 255 characters)
actions.createCampaign.props.mark_comple: Mark the campaign complete when there are no leads left to call
actions.createCampaign.props.max_calls_i: 1–10 simultaneous calls (your plan may limit further)
actions.createCampaign.props.name.descri: Name of the outbound campaign (max 255 characters)
actions.createCampaign.props.phone_numbe: Optional. Caller IDs for this campaign (distinct phone number IDs).
actions.createCampaign.props.retry_on_go: Retry when the call goal was not completed
actions.createCampaign.props.retry_on_vo: Retry when the call reaches voicemail
actions.createCampaign.props.timezone.de: IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Berlin, America/New_York). Leave empty for account default.
actions.createConversation.description: Start a new chat conversation with an AI assistant.
actions.createConversation.props.assista: The UUID of the assistant to start the conversation with
actions.createConversation.props.variabl: Custom variables to pass to the assistant
actions.deleteCall.description: Permanently delete a call record including its transcript and recording.
actions.deleteCall.props.call_id.descrip: Numeric ID of the call to delete permanently (transcript, recording, and metadata are removed)
actions.deleteLead.description: Permanently delete a lead and abort any ongoing calls.
actions.generateAiReply.description: Generate an AI reply from an assistant for a given customer.
actions.generateAiReply.props.assistant_: Select the assistant to generate a response with
actions.generateAiReply.props.customer_i: A unique identifier for the customer (e.g., phone number, email, CRM contact ID). Maximum length: 255 characters.
actions.generateAiReply.props.message.de: The customer's message to respond to
Optional context variables to pass to the assistant
actions.getCall.description: Retrieve details for a call by ID, including transcript and recording.
actions.getCall.props.call_id.descriptio: Numeric ID of the call (from list calls or Famulor UI)
actions.getConversation.description: Retrieve the full message history for a conversation.
actions.getConversation.props.uuid.descr: The unique UUID identifier of the conversation to retrieve
actions.getCurrentUser.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile and account balance.
actions.getWhatsAppSenders.description: List WhatsApp Business senders linked to your account.
Online only (default API behavior) or all senders including offline. Use sender `id` as sender_id when sending WhatsApp messages.
actions.getWhatsAppSessionStatus.descrip: Check if a 24-hour WhatsApp messaging session is active for a sender and recipient.
actions.getWhatsAppSessionStatus.props.r: Recipient to check the 24-hour window for (E.164 format: +1234567890)
actions.getWhatsAppSessionStatus.props.s: WhatsApp sender ID from Get WhatsApp Senders
actions.getWhatsAppTemplates.description: List approved WhatsApp message templates for a sender.
actions.getWhatsAppTemplates.props.sende: WhatsApp sender numeric ID from Get WhatsApp Senders (the sender `id` field)
actions.getWhatsAppTemplates.props.statu: Approved templates only (default API behavior) or all templates including pending/rejected
actions.listCalls.props.per_page.descrip: Results per page (1–100). API default is 15.
actions.listConversations.props.assistan: Filter by assistant numeric ID (must belong to your account)
actions.listConversations.props.cursor.d: Pagination cursor (paste next_cursor from a previous list response)
actions.listConversations.props.per_page: Page size (1–100). Default on the API is 15 if omitted.
actions.listConversations.props.whatsapp: Filter by WhatsApp Business sender number (exact match)
actions.listLeads.description: List all leads in your account.
actions.listPhoneNumbers.description: List all phone numbers linked to your account.
actions.makePhoneCall.description: Initiate an AI-powered phone call to a customer.
actions.makePhoneCall.props.assistant_id: Select the AI assistant to use for the call
actions.makePhoneCall.props.phone_number: Enter the phone number to call (E.164 format: +1234567890)
actions.makePhoneCall.props.variable.des: Variables to pass to the assistant during the call
actions.purchasePhoneNumber.description: Purchase a phone number from the available search results.
actions.purchasePhoneNumber.props.phone_: Exact E.164 value from Search Available Phone Numbers. Requires a payment method on file; creates a monthly subscription. (E.164 format: +1234567890)
actions.searchAvailablePhoneNumbers.desc: Search for phone numbers available to purchase.
actions.searchAvailablePhoneNumbers.prop: Optional. Only return numbers that contain these digits (numeric only, max 10 digits).
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to search in (supported regions per Famulor docs).
actions.sendMessage.description: Send a message to an existing conversation and receive the assistant's reply.
actions.sendMessage.props.message.descri: User message to send (max 2000 characters). The assistant's reply is returned in the action output field `message`.
actions.sendMessage.props.uuid.descripti: The unique UUID identifier of the conversation
actions.sendSms.description: Send an SMS message using one of your purchased phone numbers.
actions.sendSms.props.bodysuit.descripti: SMS message content (max 300 characters). Long messages may be split into multiple segments.
actions.sendSms.props.from.description: Select an SMS-capable phone number to send from
actions.sendSms.props.to.description: Enter the recipient's phone number (E.164 format: +1234567890)
actions.sendWhatsAppFreeform.description: Send a free-text WhatsApp message within an active 24-hour session.
actions.sendWhatsAppFreeform.props.messa: Free-text content (max 4096 characters). Only works within an active 24-hour messaging window; otherwise send a template first.
actions.sendWhatsAppFreeform.props.sende: WhatsApp sender ID from Get WhatsApp Senders (sender must be online)
actions.sendWhatsAppTemplate.description: Send an approved WhatsApp template message via a Famulor sender.
actions.sendWhatsAppTemplate.props.recip: Optional. Used for conversation tracking and CRM (max 255 characters)
actions.sendWhatsAppTemplate.props.sende: WhatsApp sender ID from Get WhatsApp Senders
actions.sendWhatsAppTemplate.props.templ: Template ID from Get WhatsApp Templates (must be approved)
actions.sendWhatsAppTemplate.props.varia: Key-value pairs: use "1", "2", … or names from the template `variables` array. Leave empty if the template has no placeholders.
actions.updateLead.props.campaign.descri: Optionally assign the lead to a different campaign
actions.updateLead.props.phone_number.de: New phone number in E.164 format (leave empty to keep unchanged) (E.164 format: +1234567890)
actions.updateLead.props.status.descript: Lead status: created, completed, or reached-max-retries (leave unselected to keep unchanged)
actions.updateLead.props.variables.descr: Custom fields merged with existing lead variables (leave empty to skip)
auth.description: Create an API key in your Famulor account and paste the value here. Get API key here -> https://app.famulor.de.
description: AI-powered calling and SMS platform. Automate outbound campaigns, manage leads, and get real-time call analytics.
triggers.conversationEnded.description: Triggers when a chat conversation ends.
triggers.conversationEnded.props.assista: Select the assistant whose chat conversations (WhatsApp or web widget) should send this webhook when a conversation ends
triggers.getAssistants.description: Triggers when AI assistants are created or updated in your Famulor account.
triggers.getAssistants.props.per_page.de: Number of assistants to fetch per page (1-100, default: 10)
triggers.inboundCall.description: Triggers when an inbound call is received by your AI assistant.
Select an inbound assistant to receive webhook notifications for
triggers.phoneCallEnded.description: Triggers when a phone call completes.
triggers.phoneCallEnded.props.assistant_: Select an assistant to receive post-call webhook notifications for
